LESSON: NETBALL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.5: Netball

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Netball. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the importance of dodging and marking skill in a game of Netball?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the execution of different passes in Netball
2. perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition
3. perform footwork skills in a Netball game situation
4. appreciate teamwork in application of netball skills for fun and enjoyment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: NETBALL
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Netball helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: NETBALL
Study Netball like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe the execution of different passes in Netball

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the execution of different passes in Netball. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the execution of different passes in Netball.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Netball” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the execution of different passes in Netball. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition

What this means
In this part you learn to perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Netball in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Perform footwork skills in a Netball game situation

What this means
In this part you learn to perform footwork skills in a Netball game situation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform footwork skills in a Netball game situation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform footwork skills in a Netball game situation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Appreciate teamwork in application of netball skills for fun and enjoyment

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate teamwork in application of netball skills for fun and enjoyment. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate teamwork in application of netball skills for fun and enjoyment.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Netball” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate teamwork in application of netball skills for fun and enjoyment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Netball is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Netball” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the execution of different passes in Netball)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Netball in your own words. (skill: perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: perform footwork skills in a Netball game situation)

Example 4: Show how “Netball” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate teamwork in application of netball skills for fun and enjoyment)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Netball to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the execution of different passes in Netball.
3. Practise this skill: perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition.
4. Practise this skill: perform footwork skills in a Netball game situation.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Netball from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Netball: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Netball?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the importance of dodging and marking skill in a game of Netball?
2. What footwork options does a player have after landing with a ball in a Netball game?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Netball means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the execution of different passes in Netball.
5. Be able to: perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
